tor.executable.description: The tor.exe to run. Empty: the Tor Expert Bundle setup.bat installs (vendor/tor).

tor.exitCountries.description: Leave Tor only through exits in these countries (two-letter codes such as de, nl, us). Empty: any exit. Fewer exits are slower and easier for a site to block.

tor.stopAfterSeconds.description: Tor stops when nothing has asked for it this long, and starts again when asked (a warm start takes a few seconds). 0: it runs until IED stops.
